scope: Focused producer project/index/PNG admission only; not complete service acceptance or CI.
commands: npx eslint server/types.ts server/strict-json.ts server/project-admission.ts server/project.worker.ts server/png-admission.ts tests/private-admission.test.ts

firstObservations.callableStubs: 11 tests failed as expected against explicit not-implemented stub; initial cancellation assertion also produced post-test rejection activity because the stub lacked all lifecycle behavior. No missing import/module was counted as an algorithm failure.
firstObservations.indexStub: One exact metadata/index test failed against explicit not-implemented index stub.
firstObservations.firstActual: 11/12 passed; one fixture expected raw input object-key order rather than JSON.stringify(validateProject(input)) canonical order. Changed that assertion to complete detached object equality; image bytes remain exact. No production change for this fixture correction.
firstObservations.actualDefect: CRC-valid high-bit ancillary name (0xF4) was masked to ASCII t by Buffer.toString(ascii) and incorrectly admitted. Literal focused case failed with Missing expected rejection. Validate all four raw type bytes as ASCII letters before name decoding. Full suite then passes.

final.typecheck: Owned modules have no diagnostics; whole-project check at this checkpoint had three in-flight errors in other owners private-api.ts/private-links-fixtures.ts. Root performs final integrated typecheck/build.

coverage: 30 fully decoded original PNGs covering all 15 legal type/depth dialects, both ordinary and 5x5 Adam7
Gray/RGB/palette tRNS and literal unknown ancillary preservation
Critical and ancillary CRC, complete extents/EOF, contiguous IDAT, APNG/unknown-critical/high-bit-name rejection
Actual corrupt, short, overinflated, trailing and concatenated zlib streams
Fatal UTF-8, decoded duplicate keys, finite numbers, depth bounds
Canonical schema2 JSON/SHA, detached bytes, legal negative-zero model geometry preserved
Actual singleton worker busy/cancellation/termination and pre-abort
limitations: No measured peak RSS, photographic complexity or general performance claim. Explicit PNG input/inflated/output bounds supplement V8 heap bounds; native buffers are not covered by V8 limits alone.
Tests use literal zero-filter standard PNG streams; independent oracle adds separate pixel/filter/maximum fixtures.
Timeout behavior implemented with monotonic success recheck and worker termination; this suite does not claim an observed 30-second timeout.
No browser, TLS, flock, durable store, maximum service or physical-device acceptance claimed.
